description:
Create a new survey titled '2025 Employee Engagement Pulse' in LimeSurvey. Configure it to automatically capture employee metadata using the token table and hidden fields. 

1. Initialize the survey participants (tokens) table and create two custom attributes: 'Department' (attribute_1) and 'JobRole' (attribute_2).
2. Add a participant: Elena Rossi (elena.rossi@acmecorp.com) with Department='Engineering' and JobRole='Senior Developer'.
3. Create a question group 'Data Capture'.
4. Add two Short Free Text questions with codes 'sys_dept' and 'sys_role'.
5. Configure both questions to be HIDDEN ('Always hide this question' = Yes).
6. Set the 'Default answer' value for 'sys_dept' to pull the first token attribute (use syntax {TOKEN:ATTRIBUTE_1}).
7. Set the 'Default answer' value for 'sys_role' to pull the second token attribute (use syntax {TOKEN:ATTRIBUTE_2}).
8. Add a visible 5-Point Choice question (code: 'satisfaction') asking 'Overall, how satisfied are you with your work environment?'.
